Application Materials.content:
- Complete set of supporting documents (must be legible) have to be uploaded via the application portal. Do not send paper copies. Late submission will not be accepted. The School may contact applicants for additional information or documents at a later date (if required).
- You must upload electronic copies of your supporting documents to the application portal. Documents uploaded must be in English. Otherwise, they must be accompanied by certified translations in English language.
- Passport/Identification card (NRIC): Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR) has to upload NRIC and Re-entry permit; a copy of the personal particulars page of your passport or identification card.
- One recent passport-sized colour photograph: image showing full face must be taken within the last 3 months; photograph must be in colour and taken against a white background.
- Valid TOEFL/IELTS/GRE/GMAT Scores.
- Degree Certification and Official Transcripts (Bachelor and/or Masters): degree certificate in original language and official translation in English if original is not in English; official transcripts in original language, official translation in English if original is not in English, and grading or marking scale of the transcript (Interpretation of Grades/Marks). Translation can be done by the Home University or any official authorized parties.
- Note on Official Transcripts: A copy of official transcript with detailed academic results (marks obtained in each subject, not just grades obtained, wherever possible) is required from each university attended. It should show the university name with the official stamp or it should be certified and translated by the university. If the transcript is in a language other than English, provide an official English translation as well and the subjects in the translation should be listed in the same order as that of the original transcript. The applicant is responsible for requesting transcripts from his/her university or universities.
- Expected Graduation Certificate (if applicable): Applicants who have not yet graduated must submit an official document from their university indicating their expected graduation date. Applicants must ensure that the expected graduation date allows completion of their current degree before the commencement of the intended semester/trimester intake.
- Other supporting documents (if applicable): Resume.

Interview Requirements.content: Applicants without TOEFL/IELTS would still be eligible to apply, but they may be subjected to an interview/test if deemed necessary by the School.

Application Deadlines.content: There are two intakes each year – January and August. Online application opens in **July 2026 to August 2026** for the **January 2027** intake. Applications may be made through this [portal](https://wis.ntu.edu.sg/webexe/owa/coal_main.notice). Online application opens in **October 2026 to March 2027** for the **August 2027** intake. Applications may be made through this [portal](https://wis.ntu.edu.sg/webexe/owa/coal_main.notice).

Academic Requirements.content:
- Have a **good Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent in a related discipline**.
- Applicants may also qualify with **good polytechnic qualifications in applied materials analytics or closely related major with a substantial number of years of relevant work experience**.
- The programme is suitable for **graduates with a background in materials science, engineering, physics, or related disciplines** who are interested in applying analytical tools to real-world engineering challenges.
- It is also suitable for **materials, mechanical, civil, chemical, aerospace, and electrical engineers**, professionals in semiconductor manufacturing, aerospace, marine engineering, construction, and advanced manufacturing involved in quality, reliability, or failure investigations, and engineers/researchers in analytical laboratories or R&D environments.
- **These are minimum admission requirements. Meeting these criteria does not guarantee admission, as selection is competitive.** All applicants will be holistically evaluated academically, relevancy of work experience and other relevant experiences.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content: GRE is not required for MSc programme (by coursework).

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
For applicants whose native language is not English, TOEFL/IELTS score is to be submitted with the application for admission.
| Minimum Score Required(Test dates must be within **2 years or less from the date of application**) |
| --- |
| **TOEFL iBT ≥ 85 (internet-based)** |
| **OR** |
| **IELTS ≥ 6.0** |
Applicants without TOEFL/IELTS would still be eligible to apply, but they may be subjected to an interview/test if deemed necessary by the School.

Program Overview.content:
Newly introduced in 2026, the Master of Science in Applied Materials Analytics expands NTU MSE’s postgraduate coursework offerings in response to **growing industry demand for expertise in materials characterisation, diagnostics, and failure analysis**. The programme focuses specifically on the **analytical techniques and investigative approaches** used to understand how materials behave under real operating conditions, including applications across semiconductor devices, aerospace systems, sustainable infrastructure, and advanced manufacturing.
The MSc in Applied Materials Analytics is designed for those who wish to develop advanced capabilities in materials characterisation, diagnostics, and failure investigation. The programme is suitable for materials, mechanical, civil, chemical, aerospace, and electrical engineers; professionals in semiconductor manufacturing, aerospace, marine engineering, construction, and advanced manufacturing; engineers and researchers in analytical laboratories or R&D environments; and graduates with a background in materials science, engineering, physics, or related disciplines.
By combining advanced analytical techniques with case-based learning in failure analysis, the programme equips students with practical skills directly relevant to industrial and research environments. Graduates are prepared for roles requiring expertise in materials diagnostics, reliability, and analytical investigation, including Materials Analyst / Materials Scientist, Failure Analysis Engineer, Characterisation Scientist / Engineer, Quality Assurance / Quality Control Engineer, Process Engineer, Laboratory / Analytical Scientist, Research and Development (R&D) Engineer, and Technical Specialist / Applications Engineer. These roles are in demand across semiconductors, aerospace, energy, marine engineering, infrastructure, biomedical technology, and advanced manufacturing. Graduates may also pursue research careers in industrial laboratories, government agencies, or doctoral programmes.
Students learn from a Materials Science and Engineering faculty whose expertise and research provide insights and mentorship for careers in the field. The programme offers a mixed-learning approach that combines asynchronous online learning with conventional face-to-face teaching.
Programme structure: MSc students are enrolled on the coursework study option by default, requiring 30 AUs, made up of 10 AUs of core courses and 20 AUs of elective courses. Students may opt in to a coursework and dissertation route requiring 24 AUs of coursework, made up of 10 AUs core courses and 14 AUs elective courses, plus a 6 AU dissertation. Total graduation requirement is 30 AUs and a minimum CGPA of 2.5.
| Study mode | Minimum Candidature | Maximum Candidature |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full Time Study | 1 year (2 semesters) | 3 years (6 semesters) |
| Part Time Study | 2 years (4 semesters) | 4 years (8 semesters) |

Cost of Attendance.content: For international students, the required amount of the living expenses is estimated at S$18,000 per year, in addition to the tuition and miscellaneous student fees.

Financial Aid.content:
- FlexiMasters (15 AU) is **Subsidised by SSG** and is applicable to **Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents**.
- The MSc in Applied Materials Analytics pathway is **Self-Funded**.

Multiple Applications.content:
- Applicants has to use the same application number if applying for more than one programme in the same intake (i.e. August intake). For applications under different intake, please use a new application number.
- Application fee will be charged for each Coursework application.
- Application fee payment can be made online before submitting application by VISA/Mastercard. Please ensure that application fee is made to the correct Coursework Application Number (eg C22xxxxx) and programme code. Application fee payment is non-transferable and non-refundable.

Deferral Admission Policy.content:
- Deferments are evaluated on a case-by-case basis and granted only under special circumstances.
- If you wish to defer, please reach out to your respective school for approval.
- NTU advises that you do not accept the offer at this time and instead re-apply for the programme of your interest when you are ready.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
A conditional offer is extended to an applicant who is in the process of completing the final term, semester, or trimester of their current course of study, and has outstanding educational documents. This condition will be clearly outlined in the offer letter, stating: "The offer of admission is on condition that you obtain your Bachelor's degree with a ________ from ___________ , ___________"
For **Conditional Offer** (i.e. subject to attaining a Bachelor/ Masters’ degree), students are required to upload their **Bachelor/ Masters’ degree scrolls and Official Transcript** (Original and English Language translated). If unable to upload the Bachelor/ Masters’ degree scroll during verification period, students are to upload **a letter of completion** from their university stating that they have completed and attained Bachelor/ Masters’ degree. **Do not complete e-verification if you do not meet the condition stated on the offer letter.** Kindly contact your school for assistance.
International students with international qualifications under a Conditional Offer must submit:
- **Official degree certificate and final transcript**
- Digital copy of Student Pass (Full-time students) / Valid immigration pass (For Part-time students only)
- **Degree verification report (English)** from NTU approved credential verification agency **within one month of your term start date**
- Latest Passport (If not yet submitted)
